camel_example: aliyun iot ReplaceEdgeInstanceGateway --region cn-hangzhou --CurrentGatewayId oTCJomvT95WPyPPQ5sje000000 --InstanceId G4TGWGYwpo8zwr000000 --NewGatewayId 65SkFyhZcU5d3PO2Ri13000000
description_en: Replaces the gateway bound to an edge instance. After the gateway is replaced, the deployment status and deployment history of the original gateway are cleared
description_zh: 替换已绑定到边缘实例的网关。替换网关后，原网关的部署状态和部署历史会被清除
kebab_example: aliyun iot replace-edge-instance-gateway --instance-id G4TGWGYwpo8zwr000000 --current-gateway-id oTCJomvT95WPyPPQ5sje000000 --new-gateway-id 65SkFyhZcU5d3PO2Ri13000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReplaceEdgeInstanceGateway

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You do not need to specify this parameter for public instances, but you must specify it for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the edge instance. You can obtain the ID by moving the pointer over the name of the target edge instance on the Edge Instances page in the Edge Computing console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例的ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IotId of the current gateway device. The IotId is the unique identifier that is generated by IoT Platform for the device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation to query the IotId
parameters.help_zh: 当前网关设备的IotId。IotId是物联网平台为设备生成的唯一标识符。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html接口查询
parameters.name: current_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The IotId of the new gateway device. The IotId is the unique identifier that is generated by IoT Platform for the device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation to query the IotId
parameters.help_zh: 要替换的新网关设备的IotId。IotId是物联网平台为设备生成的唯一标识符。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html接口查询
parameters.name: new_gateway_id

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates that the call was successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
